hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Wire-wrapped screen
function: The keystone wire wrap on ribs over the base pipe whose slot holds the gravel while letting fluid through.

tabs.overview: Slot sized below the smallest gravel; premium mesh screens use woven layers for finer sand; designed and tested to ISO 17824.
tabs.safety: Handled with protectors; erosion at high rates or with a void in the pack.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sand control techniques (S42), ISO 17824 for screens (S47), API RP 19C for gravel testing (S12 if held), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
